مِسْحَجٌ The [instrument called] مِبْرَاة with which one pares, or shapes, wood. (O, K.) ―
-b2- [And hence, app., A rain that is as though it pared the surface of the earth. Accord. to Freytag, مَسْحَجٌ occurs in this sense in the Deewán of Jereer: pl. مَسَاحِجُ: but the correct word is evidently مِسْحَجٌ.] ―
-b3- Also, and ↓ مِسْحَاجٌ , (O, K, TA,) A wild ass that bites [other asses] much, or frequently: (TA:) [or each signifies, though not so expl. in the TA,] an ass [i. e. a wild ass] that runs a pace falling short of such as is vehement. (O. K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
